data.description:
## Description

**What**: Implement tickets orphan-branch creation post-overlay; explicit `git push origin tickets` exit-code check; remote conflict surfaced with clear error and exit non-zero.
**Why**: DSO requires the tickets orphan branch; silent push failures leave the user without ticket sync and are hard to diagnose.
**Scope**:
- IN: tickets orphan branch creation step (post-overlay); push to origin if a remote is configured; exit-code check; named error on conflict.
- OUT: Skipping push when no remote (continue without error); branch protection / rule provisioning (out of scope per epic).

## Done Definitions
- When complete, the tickets orphan branch exists locally after the installer completes ← Satisfies: SC1
- When complete, when a remote is configured the push succeeds OR fails with a clear named error and non-zero exit ← Satisfies: SC1
- When complete, when no remote is configured the step skips silently ← Satisfies: SC1
- When complete, unit tests written and passing for both push-success and push-failure paths

## Considerations
- [Reliability] Distinguish 'no remote configured' from 'push failed' in logging

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a maintainer, tickets orphan branch is created post-overlay and remote push errors surface clearly
